drive: KIOXIA EXCERIA PLUS G3 NVMe, C: NTFS 1 TB
method: Baseline is 0.1.1 (commit 9db6966), optimized is 0.2.0. Runs alternate baseline and optimized; medians shown. Warm caches. Directory scans run outside any sandbox (filter drivers change their cost). Headless numbers come from scripts/bench.go, GUI numbers from the real Quarry.exe scanning C:\ (time until results are shown, process working set and private bytes sampled every 50 ms, settled 8 s after results).

mft_scan_c.note: The MFT is 1,420 MiB; raw volume reads top out near 1 GB/s on this drive, so about 1.4 s is the floor. Baseline lost 14,755 records whose folder's name is stored in an MFT extension record (C:\Windows\WinSxS among them) and listed them at the root as unresolved.

ui_on_c_mft_snapshot.source: TestPerfReport, 1,310,435 entries, 1600x1000 headless frames (layout, shaping, painting; no GPU presentation)
ui_on_c_mft_snapshot.frames: Idle, scrolling, 200,000-row tree and treemap-hover frames stay at 0-2 ms median (worst 10-12 ms) in both versions; per-frame allocation fell 20-30%.

index_operations_on_c_mft_snapshot_ms.note: [baseline, optimized]. CSV export allocations fell from 605 MB / 12.3 M to 5.7 MB / 82 K; snapshot save from 71 MB to 16 MB.

limitations: Single machine; NVMe throughput varied by up to 30% between sessions, so only same-session alternating runs are compared.
Headless frame costs exclude GPU presentation.
No same-machine WizTree benchmark was performed.

release_0_2_1.method: [0.2.0, 0.2.1] pairs. 0.2.0 (commit d79d916) against 0.2.1 on one saved directory scan of C:\ (1,432,730 entries): scripts/bench.go -load -ops -runs 5 in five alternating process pairs, TestPerfReport in three alternating runs, medians. A parity tool hashed the ordered results of 12 searches, 12 sorts, Analyze, the treemap layout, ExportJSON and FindDuplicatesOver (20 MB) in both builds: all identical.

mft_scan_c_ms.note: Cold first runs excluded. CPU 578-640 ms before, 343-453 ms after.

release_0_2_1.note: install_scan is slower because the parallel loader leaves more garbage to collect right after loading; load plus install is 418 -> 118 ms. Frame times were unchanged within noise.
